title: Brandon Aiyuk continues to push 49ers to release him, says on social media that he has no agent

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aiyuk continues to push 49ers to release him, says on social media that he has no agent
sources.description: Aiyuk wants to sign with the Commanders once he's released. Yet he also hasn't applied for reinstatement from the Reserve/Left Squad list that would allow the 49ers to cut him.
